steps.what: Define actual embedded software requirements, hardware interfaces, timing constraints and test cases
inputs: actual hardware interface specifications and intended behavior
actual processor constraints and existing source revision
outputs: engineer-authored software requirements, interfaces and test cases

steps.what: Create embedded software design programs in the embedded development environment (OPS_SYSTEM), authoring and revising implementation code
inputs: engineer-authored software requirements, interfaces and test cases
actual existing source revision and permitted hardware-interface definitions
outputs: engineer-reviewed candidate embedded source patch

loop.purpose: Draft a bounded source patch implementing engineer-defined behavior
loop.input: Exact source revision, explicit interface definitions and engineer-authored requirements/tests
loop.output: Candidate patch with requirement and interface references
loop.check: Engineer reviews semantics; compiler, static checks and tests check executable behavior, with hardware/timing checks retained separately
loop.stop: Stop on missing interfaces, unresolved timing/behavior, failed checks or two unsuccessful revisions; engineer writes manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Compiler and templates cannot author a new behavioral implementation; use them first for boilerplate and checks, restricting the model to code drafting

steps.what: Compile and test the candidate embedded program, check timing and hardware behavior using the existing authorised development/test setup, and diagnose failures
inputs: engineer-reviewed candidate embedded source patch
engineer-authored software requirements, interfaces and test cases
existing isolated authorised test setup
outputs: actual test results, timing findings and corrected candidate source

steps.what: Review the exact final embedded source diff, test evidence, requirements coverage and intended source-control destination
inputs: actual test results, timing findings and corrected candidate source
actual requirements and source-control branch
outputs: exact checked final source revision, evidence and internal commit destination

steps.what: Commit the exact checked embedded source revision to the intended internal source-control branch
inputs: exact checked final source revision, evidence and internal commit destination
outputs: internal embedded source commit

tasks.design: Use native compiler, templates and tests first in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the embedded software development/source-control environment, adding a bounded code-drafting loop for actual new behavior. The engineer supplies requirements, checks semantics and real timing/hardware evidence, then commits the exact checked internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: New behavioral code requires authoring beyond fixed templates.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded code-drafting aid can propose source patches against explicit interfaces and tests.
tasks.still_hard: A passing build does not establish correct physical behavior, timing or fault response.
tasks.human_edge: Choose behavior and recognise test gaps and unsafe assumptions.

ambition.what: No autonomous merge or production firmware deployment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; engineering owner approves source access and drafting environment

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded code drafting can assist embedded implementation, while compilation alone cannot verify hardware behavior or timing.

assumptions: Unmeasured code-authoring scenario. Gross 40 x .25 = 10; incremental upkeep 2; net 8 hours per 100.
Engineer produces requirements/tests in s1 and captures actual test evidence in s3. Missing interface or timing information stops drafting; no free formal specification assumed.
Existing compiler, test execution and native boilerplate already happen today and earn no additional saving. All review, repair and physical behavior checking remain counted.
s3 uses an already authorised isolated development setup and proposes no new machine energisation or deployment; such work requires its own actual readiness and action steps if present.
Internal source commit is 1 fully retained point, approximately zero today, with no saving. Final exact diff/evidence/destination check s4 gates commit; edits void it.
unknowns: Actual authoring gain after correction and test effort
research_questions: Does a bounded patch aid reduce measured total source-authoring effort with the same hardware and timing checks?

already_counted.description: Requirements, patch review/repair, testing and final revision verification

incremental.description: Maintain permitted source context, drafting checks and evaluation cases

approvals.approved_version: Exact final source diff, test evidence and branch checked in s4; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 code-drafting scenario below modeled 8% net; unsuccessful drafting may yield zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design electronic controls for mechanical systems

steps.what: Establish actual mechanical-system behavior, electronic interfaces and control requirements
inputs: actual mechanical plant characteristics and operating envelope
actual sensors, actuators and interface constraints
outputs: engineer-defined control requirements and plant assumptions

steps.what: Design advanced electronic control systems for mechanical systems, choosing control architecture, electronics and fault handling
inputs: engineer-defined control requirements and plant assumptions
actual component data and operating constraints
outputs: engineer-selected electronic control architecture and behavior

steps.what: Author actual electronic schematics and control analysis setup in electronic CAD/control analysis software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected electronic control architecture and behavior
engineer-entered component values, connections and plant parameters
outputs: complete electronic control design and analysis draft

steps.what: Check completed electronic design, analysis assumptions, interfaces and actual requirements against the intended internal revision
inputs: complete electronic control design and analysis draft
actual requirements, plant assumptions and destination
outputs: exact checked final electronic control design and revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked electronic control design as its intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked final electronic control design and revision destination
outputs: saved internal electronic control design

tasks.design: Configure native component symbols and analysis setup profiles in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the electronic CAD/control analysis system. The engineer defines the plant and control behavior, supplies actual connections and parameters, checks the final design and saves its exact internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated schematic and analysis setup adds drafting work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable symbols and setup profiles can reduce repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Plant uncertainty, stability and fault behavior need engineering validation.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and challenge the control architecture and model.

ambition.what: No automatic equipment release or controller deployment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; electronics owner validates library and analysis profiles

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: electronic CAD libraries and analysis profiles can reduce repeated authoring without selecting correct control behavior.

assumptions: Unmeasured repeated-setup scenario. Gross 35 x .10 = 3.5; upkeep 1; net 2.5 hours per 100.
Actual component values, connections and plant parameters are produced and entered by the engineer in s1-s3, not inferred by a drafting tool.
Existing simulation computation is already today's means; only new repeated setup reuse earns saving. No physical commissioning is included in this design episode.
Same-system save has 1 fully retained point and no saving. Completed-design check s4 gates exact version/destination; edits invalidate it.
research_questions: Which schematic and analysis setup operations are still repeated manually?

already_counted.description: Requirements, architecture and final electronic design verification

incremental.description: Maintain and test electronic libraries and setup profiles

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed electronic design and intended revision checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-setup scenario below 2.5% modeled net; no automatic design benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Determine actual mechanical loading, failure modes and observable condition indicators for the proposed self-monitoring system
inputs: actual mechanical-system requirements and operating history where available
actual loading envelope and component/failure evidence
outputs: engineer-defined monitoring objectives, failure hypotheses and evidence gaps

steps.what: Design self-monitoring mechanical systems, such as gear systems that monitor loading or condition to detect and prevent failures, selecting sensing and response logic
inputs: engineer-defined monitoring objectives, failure hypotheses and evidence gaps
actual sensor limitations and mechanical interface constraints
outputs: engineer-selected sensing locations, signal interpretation and condition-response design

steps.what: Author the actual mechanical/sensor layout and monitoring design model in mechanical CAD/analysis software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: engineer-selected sensing locations, signal interpretation and condition-response design
actual geometry, sensor dimensions and engineer-entered model parameters
outputs: complete self-monitoring mechanical design model

steps.what: Check the completed monitoring design against loading, detectability, false alarms, failure response and intended internal revision
inputs: complete self-monitoring mechanical design model
actual monitoring objectives, evidence and identified gaps
outputs: exact checked final monitoring design with limitations and revision destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked self-monitoring design as the intended internal revision
inputs: exact checked final monitoring design with limitations and revision destination
outputs: saved internal self-monitoring mechanical design

tasks.design: Configure native sensor/component placement and fixed-property reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the mechanical CAD/analysis system. The engineer determines actual failure hypotheses and sensing/response logic, authors the design and checks its limits before saving the internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated sensor geometry and fixed-property drafting adds model-entry effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native component reuse can reduce repeated model construction.
tasks.still_hard: A measurable signal does not establish reliable failure detection or prevention.
tasks.human_edge: Identify valid condition indicators and challenge false-alarm and missed-failure risks.

ambition.what: No claim of new predictive accuracy or automatic operational intervention.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; mechanical/condition-monitoring owner validates components and access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native engineering component reuse can reduce layout work, while monitoring hypotheses and response validity require engineering assessment.

assumptions: Unmeasured repeated-layout scenario. Gross 25 x .10 = 2.5; upkeep 1; net 1.5 hours per 100.
Engineer obtains actual load/failure evidence and enters sensor/model properties in s1-s3. Missing history or observability evidence remains a gap, never invented training data.
This designs the system, not a free deployed sensor pipeline or trained failure predictor. Existing CAD and calculation runtime already belong to today's work.
Save is 1 fully retained point with no saving. s4 checks the completed exact design, limitations and destination before s5; edits require recheck.
unknowns: Repeated geometry burden and available failure evidence
research_questions: Which component drafting is genuinely repeated, and what physical evidence supports each monitored indicator?

already_counted.description: Failure assessment, sensing design and completed-design verification

incremental.description: Maintain sensor geometry/property library and validate updates

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed monitoring design, limits and revision destination checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-layout scenario below 1.5% modeled net; monitoring decisions fully retained.

actual process and equipment operating constraints

engineer-entered actual instrument tags, ranges and interface definitions
outputs: complete environmental control design draft

steps.what: Check the complete environmental control design against actual process constraints, instrument definitions, fault responses and internal revision destination

engineer-established process/control requirements and interfaces

steps.what: Save the exact checked environmental control design as the intended internal revision

tasks.design: For the waste-processing design route, configure native instrument symbols and fixed tag/property reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the control-engineering design system. The engineer studies the actual process, designs control behavior, supplies instrument facts and checks the complete design before saving its internal revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated instrument and tag drafting adds document-entry effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native control-design libraries can reuse known symbols and fixed properties.
tasks.still_hard: Process behavior, environmental constraints and fault responses require application-specific engineering.
tasks.human_edge: Connect environmental objectives to defensible real equipment behavior.

ambition.what: No automatic plant deployment or claim of improved environmental performance.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; process and control owners approve design access and reusable fields

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native control-design libraries can reduce repeated instrument drafting while process control decisions and checks remain human.

assumptions: Unmeasured waste-process design episode, one stated environmental application. Gross 29 x .10 = 2.9; upkeep 1; net 1.9 hours per 100.
Engineer produces actual process requirements, instrument tags and interface definitions in s1-s3; no free instrument inventory or inferred operating limits.
Existing engineering software and calculation runtime already happen today. Only repeated drafting changes; commissioning, permit submission and plant-control actions are not promised.
Same-system save is 1 fully retained point with no saving. Completed-design check s4 gates exact version/destination; edits void the check.
unknowns: Existing native instrument reuse and drafting effort
research_questions: Which actual instrument/tag fields are retyped and which process facts need renewed field verification?

incremental.description: Maintain and validate instrument symbols and fixed property reuse

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed environmental control design and internal destination checked in s4; edits require recheck
